description: Replayable §4.1c patches for every new accountable-threshold verdict family. The runner requires an unmutated pass, a non-empty source change, a moved production bundle hash, the named test red, and a byte-identical restore with that test green. Browser mutations always use --retries=0 and CI=1.

mutations.test: accountable signature verifies only against keys named by J
mutations.why: Forces V to ignore J and aggregate every registered key.

mutations.test: threshold policy rejects a valid t-minus-one BLS sum
mutations.why: Removes the |J| = t policy while leaving the pairing equation intact.

mutations.find: return sigma === undefined || publicKey === undefined || !atsVerifyShare(publicKey, message, sigma);
mutations.replace:
void message;
    return sigma === undefined || publicKey === undefined;
mutations.test: combiner blames exactly the corrupted share
mutations.why: Makes C aggregate a corrupt share instead of returning blame({j}).

mutations.test: tracer decodes edited J rather than page quorum
mutations.why: Returns mutable page state instead of decoding J from the signature.

mutations.test: bitmap labels are one-based and match encoded bits
mutations.why: Changes the signer-number convention from 1-based to 0-based.

mutations.test: proof of possession rejects rogue cancellation key
mutations.why: Lets a rogue cancellation key reach same-message aggregate verification without PopVerify.

mutations.why: Deletes the §4.1d negative claim from its evidence fixture.
